title: Clickers
description: Adds a Dog Clicker item to Minecraft. Bind it to yourself and give it to a friend one click and you're in command!
body:
Adds a Dog Clicker item to Minecraft. Bind it to yourself and give it to a friend one click and you're in command!

Uses Clicker Model and Sound from [https://github.com/jlortiz0/PlayerCollars](https://github.com/jlortiz0/PlayerCollars)

![Recipie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c88f7b2010b431eb57e9d78c628b91d9bf6535f.png)

**Guide**
- Shift Right Click: Binds to yourself (Can't be unbounded)
- Then pass to a friend
- Shift Right Click: Changes mode between Command and Sound only

**Modes:**
- Command: If bound to a player will force them out of any gui's and force them to look at you (for safety reasons will not close the pause menu)
- Audio only: Plays a click sound

Use this mod to clicker train your friends and cause chaos! 😈


This is my first mod so any feedback would be appreciated
